pantheon-tile: An application icon for Lynk, a web browser, drawn in the elementary OS Pantheon icon style, matching the shape language of elementary OS's own app icons (Files, Mail, Web, AppCenter, Tasks): simple bold geometric shapes, soft top-lit vertical gradients, a thin slightly darker outline around each shape, a crisp one-pixel inner highlight along the top edges, and a small soft drop shadow underneath. The icon is a rounded square tile with generous corner radius in deep navy blue, lighter at the top (#2a4a9a) fading to midnight (#0c1736) at the bottom. On the tile sits an open chevron, the shape of a '>' symbol rotated 45 degrees counterclockwise so its sharp tip points to the upper right: two straight tapered arms of equal length, one running left from the tip and one running down from the tip, meeting at an acute point, each arm ending in a sharp angled cut, the space between the arms empty (it is NOT a filled triangle, NOT a paper plane, NOT a cursor), in silver white with a gentle bevel, outlined by a soft royal blue (#3a6ee8) band that hugs its outer edge. Three thin pale blue diagonal motion streaks trail from the lower left toward the tip. Clean vector illustration, minimal detail, readable at 16 pixels, no text, no letters. Centered with a wide empty margin on a perfectly flat solid pure green (#00FF00) background that fills the whole square image, front view, no perspective.

mac-foreground: A single photorealistic skeuomorphic object for a macOS app icon layer: a sharp open arrowhead chevron whose tip points to the upper right. From the tip, one arm runs toward the left and slightly downward, the other arm runs downward and slightly to the left, the two arms meeting at an angle of about 70 degrees; the arms are tapered, of equal length, and end in clean angled cuts; the inside of the angle is empty (it is not a filled triangle and not a paper plane). The arms are thick and made of polished brushed silver aluminium with crisp bevelled edges, a bright specular highlight along the upper edges and soft shading on the lower facets, like a premium metal emblem. Three thin straight light blue motion streaks trail diagonally from the lower left toward the inside of the angle. The object is centered and spans about 60 percent of the frame. Soft studio lighting from the top. No cast shadow on the background, no glow, no reflection. Isolated on a perfectly flat solid pure green (#00FF00) background filling the whole square image, front orthographic view, no text.
mac-background: A full-bleed square texture for the background layer of a skeuomorphic macOS app icon, filling the entire canvas edge to edge with no border, no frame and no rounded corners: deep midnight navy blue (#0a1530 at the bottom, #1d3470 at the top) lit softly from above, with a very fine brushed-anodised-metal grain, a gentle vignette toward the corners, and a broad soft royal blue (#2c5bd0) painterly brush-stroke glow sweeping in a wide inverted L from the middle of the left edge across the upper third and down the right side. No objects, no symbols, no text, front view.
